results.name: widget_apply_random_jitter
results.evidence: Draws three random floats from the DAT_00719cd4 LCG, calls matrix4x3_transform_vector(param_1) to orient a base vector, then adds the randomly-signed, transformed offset onto unaff_ESI's position -- a small per-axis positional jitter helper.
results.summary: Applies a small random jitter, oriented by the object's transform, to a position (e.g. antenna tip wobble).

results.name: light_volume_render
results.evidence: Resolves an instance through the DAT_006b8d74 hash-slot table (same family as light_volume_new's DAT_006b8d70), then for each of the tag's markers builds a shaft/cone geometry using vector3d_normalize(_with_length) and the same render-buffer lock helpers (FUN_0051bdd0/FUN_0051be40/FUN_0051c830) used elsewhere for effect geometry.
results.summary: Builds and renders the light-shaft geometry for a light-volume instance across its tag-defined markers.

results.name: widgets_initialize
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint ties the 'widget' string to widgets_initialize; calls data_new("widget", 0x40), then antennas_initialize (FUN_004faa20) and flags_initialize (FUN_004fb4d0) directly, followed by a 5-slot vtable of per-type initializers (PTR_FUN_0069c018).
results.summary: Initializes the generic object-widget subsystem: the widget instance array plus each concrete widget type (antenna, flag, and others via a per-type vtable).

results.name: widgets_dispose
results.evidence: Sets the widget array's disposing flag and calls data_delete_all, then invokes each widget type's dispose function through the parallel vtable (PTR_FUN_0069c01c), mirroring widgets_initialize's structure.
results.summary: Disposes the widget instance array and every concrete widget type (antenna, flag, and others) it manages.

results.name: widgets_dispose_clear_flag
results.evidence: Runs each widget type's clear-flag function via a third parallel vtable (PTR_FUN_0069c020) before clearing the widget array's own disposing flag, the third stage of the antennas/flags-style dispose_clear_flag pattern applied generically.
results.summary: Clears the disposing flag for every widget type and then for the widget subsystem itself.

results.name: widget_new
results.evidence: For each attachment slot on the object's definition (+0x14c array), matches its type id against a 5-entry type table (&DAT_0069c010) and, via the matching vtable slot (PTR_FUN_0069c028), creates a new sub-instance (antenna/flag/etc.), linking the resulting widget handle into the object's widget list head at +0x16c.
results.summary: Creates a widget attachment instance of the appropriate concrete type for each matching attachment on an object, and links it into the object's widget list.

results.name: widget_delete_all
results.evidence: Walks the object's widget list (starting at +0x16c) and for each entry invokes the per-type dispose function from the vtable at &DAT_0069c02c before removing it with datum_delete, then clears the list head.
results.summary: Deletes every widget attached to an object, dispatching to each widget's type-specific dispose routine.

results.name: widget_list_has_flag
results.evidence: Walks an object's widget list checking a per-type flag byte from table &DAT_0069c014 indexed by each widget's stored type, returning true as soon as one type has the flag set.
results.summary: Returns whether any widget attached to an object belongs to a type marked in a per-type flag table.

results.name: widget_list_notify
results.evidence: Walks an object's widget list (via DAT_008603b0) and, for each entry, invokes a per-type callback from the vtable at &PTR_LAB_0069c034 selected by the widget's stored type index.
results.summary: Invokes a per-type notification callback for every widget attached to an object.

results.name: widgets_update_all
results.evidence: Runs a 5-slot vtable (PTR_FUN_0069c030) of per-type update functions -- which include antennas_update (FUN_004fad20) and flags_update (FUN_004fba00) -- forwarding param_1 (dt) to each.
results.summary: Advances every concrete widget subsystem (antennas, flags, and others) by one timestep.

results.name: zone_light_table_initialize
results.evidence: Sets a leading flag byte, fills 16 groups of 8 dwords with -1 (handle/index slots) immediately following it, then fills 16 further blocks of 256 floats with 1.0 at DAT_006b8d78+0x204 -- a fixed-size lookup/weight table whose exact subsystem is not otherwise evidenced in this batch.
results.summary: Initializes a fixed-size 16-zone table of -1 index slots followed by 16 blocks of unity-weight floats; likely a per-zone light or ambient lookup grid.

results.name: zone_light_table_test_bit
results.evidence: Tests a single bit of the same DAT_006b8d78 table addressed by (in_AX>>5 + DAT_0069e8d8*8), returning whether that bit is set for the given 16-bit index.
results.summary: Tests whether a given index's bit is set in the zone/light lookup table initialized by zone_light_table_initialize.
